title: One-step Boolean tape pop
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer, let $b$ be a Boolean value, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Starting with the machine in its initial state and with $[b]$ on work tape $0$ and every other work tape empty, after one step its state is $b$ and all work tapes are empty. The input head and work-tape heads remain at their initial positions, and the output tape remains empty.
